Small businesses and artisans have found greater access and empowerment on this platform, leading to increased engagement and a national transformation. GeM aims to focus on unlocking even more innovations and opportunities in the upcoming decade.

articles.title: This app is dropping curated mystery bags from your favourite cafes in Bengaluru

articles.title: What a water-wise city would look like – and how India can get there
articles.description: Durban and Bhubaneswar have protected water access for low-income households. Las Vegas and Bengaluru use higher tariffs to discourage excessive consumption. Seoul and Guwahati have strengthened planning rules to protect floodplains. Windhoek and Chennai show that treated wastewater can become a reliable source of water

articles.title: Dollar race: Foreign banks ramp up FCNR deposits, narrow gap with locals
articles.description: Such deposits at foreign banks surged nearly 15-fold to $8.97 billion as on 30 July, from just $603 million on 5 June, official data showed. Among the biggest gainers, HSBC saw outstanding FCNR deposits jump from $120.26 million to $6.26 billion, while Standard Chartered mobilised $1.86 billion.

articles.title: Indian refiners brace for pricier crude after September as Russia sanctions loom
articles.description: Concerns follow the US Senate’s passage of the Lindsey O. Graham Sanctioning Russia and Iran Act of 2026, to be taken up in the House of Representatives next month. The Act allows the US president to impose tariffs up to 100% on countries that are among the top five importers of Russian oil and gas.
